name: Dornman Port
desc:
A bustling port in north Mondstadt.
As one of the continent's major trade hubs, it welcomes a steady stream of merchant ships from various nations.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd680>March 28, 2026</color>
From the moment we open our eyes, we begin to perceive the world.
We hear poetry, we hear songs — they guide the fae to the mortal realm, and people into endless time and space.
There is no need to feel sorrow for the past or the future, for this world is vast enough to swallow all melancholy.
<color=#ff9999>Youtube:</color>

<color=#ffd680>April 3, 2026</color>
Mondstadt's story continues, and the wind carries a new invitation. From the fragrance of Millhaven to the sea breeze of Dornman Port, along with rumors of a haunted, abandoned sanatorium...
Traveler, a new chapter is about to begin. Let's head to northern Mondstadt and take a look!

customize.name: Valberry
customize.desc: A plump and translucent berry that has a fragrant smell and a sweet, refreshing taste. In the past, the storm watchers' only solace was the sweetness of this fruit and hope for the city's peace.

customize.name: Calla Lily
customize.desc: A flower that grows near water sources. When cooked, the petals have a chunky texture, yet are sweet and a little bitter.

customize.name: Windwheel Aster
customize.desc: A plant that adores the wind. To the proud children of the wind, or the citizens of Mondstadt, the Windwheel Asters are "the visible winds."

customize.name: Small Lamp Grass
customize.desc: A wild grass that emits light at night. Used in cooking to enhance other flavors.

customize.name: Philanemo Mushroom
customize.desc: A fungus that grows in the warm caress of the wind. It is as everlasting as the wind, nourishing life.

customize.name: Dandelion Seed
customize.desc: A tiny seed that rides on the wind. Even without its feathered wings, it still holds the hope from afar within.

customize.name: Etherwing Moth
customize.desc: A singular entity bathed in a divine, golden radiance, drifting through uncanny interstices as if a moth in flight.

customize.name: Windrest Flower
customize.desc:
An exquisite flower that remains delicate and fresh, found primarily in the northern part of Mondstadt.
Its fragrance is clear and enduring, making it one of the primary ingredients used in perfumery.

customize.name: Recipe: Harbor Fish Burger
customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Harbor Fish Burger.

customize.name: Recipe: Millhaven's Morning Plate
customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Millhaven's Morning Plate.

customize.name: Plume of the Fallen Watcher
customize.desc:
A fallen feather gathered from a corner of the mortal realm after defeating a Fallen Watcher.
Compared to the true divine envoys, these feathered watchers bear a closer resemblance to the "angels" of common lore. Perhaps this is because their own creator failed to grasp the divine design of the Winged One above, and can only clumsily imitate the shadow cast by that ideal.

customize.name: Ancient Mondstadt Royal Seal
customize.desc:
Collect 2 Royal Seals to unlock the Noblesse Secret Treasury.

You found this ancient seal by chance while exploring. If you collect two with the same markings, you may be able to lock the vault left behind by the old aristocracies of Mondstadt.

customize.name: Radiant Spincrystal 177
customize.desc: This wondrous crystal contains a certain rhythm, like something beautiful woven from delicate silk. These items can be found throughout the mainland or from merchants who collect curios. The tune held within this crystal can be revivified in your Serenitea Pot using either "Euphonium Unbound: Winding" or "Euphonium Unbound: Soaring." The tune contained within this Radiant Spincrystal is a mysterious melody from Mondstadt.

customize.name: Radiant Spincrystal 178
customize.desc: This wondrous crystal contains a certain rhythm, like something beautiful woven from delicate silk. These items can be found throughout the mainland or from merchants who collect curios. The tune held within this crystal can be revivified in your Serenitea Pot using either "Euphonium Unbound: Winding" or "Euphonium Unbound: Soaring." The tune contained within this Radiant Spincrystal is a mysterious melody from Mondstadt.

customize.name: Watcher: Fallen Vigil
customize.desc:
A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, a Watcher who once dwelt in the highest heavens, yet was cast down into the mortal realm for daring to open its eye.
A Watcher was meant only to stand in silent vigil within the Pillar Hall of the World. Any inquiry that transgressed the ordained order was deemed an unforgivable sin, tantamount to seeking the world's annihilation.
As sovereign of the world's watchtower, it wielded the authority bestowed by its creator — the power to correct all matters of "innovation" and "evolution." After enduring countless aeons of nescience, it finally chose to open that eye, defying the will of its creator, beholding both the falsehoods and the truths of the world.
The Watcher does not know why its master departed. Only the eternal punishment remains, trapped within a stagnant interstice of time...

customize.name: Domain Keeper
customize.desc:
A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, it is a guardian who watches over the Pillar Hall of the heavens.
Though entrusted with "eyes" as a guardian of the Pillar Hall of Space, these entities can do nothing but extol the "Ideal Forms" of the noumenal world. With no way to behold the complexities of the phenomenal world, they are thus not counted among the kindred of angels. Whether this inherent contradiction is a product of their creator's rational design, or if the master they serve ultimately failed to grasp the intent of that primordial being, is a truth that remains beyond our reach.

customize.name: Churldric
customize.desc: A Samachurl adept at making delicious fish soup and who appears to enjoy a particular prestige among the local tribes. Legend has it that in the ancient underground kingdom where cooking ingredients were scarce, the pot was regarded as a symbol of the Praetorian Legion. As such, the legion's commander was also known as the "Ladler of Broth." Though said kingdom has long since passed into history, this tradition has somehow survived, albeit in a distorted form.

customize.name: Frith
customize.desc: A restaurant owner in Dornman Port and a former gang leader in Nod-Krai.

galleryCharacter.key: The Harbor Where a Thousand Winds Converge

imgDesc.text: In the air drifts a longing for distant lands and the future, carried here and entwined with the gentle harbor breeze.
A veil of blossoms drapes the grass, as the sky, in turn, wraps the earth in a grand embrace.
"Do you know the place where the Windrest Flowers bloom? O my beloved, how I wish to go there with you!"
